request.style: English, gentle female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, soft percussion, warm and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
King Solomon loved many foreign women
Moabites and Ammonites were among them
From the nations the Lord had warned against
Yet he clung to them in his love

[Verse]
When the king grew old in his days
His wives turned his heart away
He followed Ashtoreth and Milcom too
His heart was no longer true

[Chorus]
Naamah the Ammonite stood in the court
Mother of Rehoboam by record
In the city the Lord had chosen she lived
Her story is what the text gives

[Verse]
Rehoboam reigned in Jerusalem
Forty-one years old when he began
He ruled for seventeen years there
His mother's name was Naamah

[Chorus]
Naamah the Ammonite stood in the court
Mother of Rehoboam by record
In the city the Lord had chosen she lived
Her story is what the text gives

[Bridge]
The people said we have no share in David
To your tents Israel go away
The tribes rebelled against the house of David
Judah alone remained to stay

[Outro]
Naamah the Ammonite is remembered
Mother of Rehoboam in the text
